answer: A signing key shatters into umber tablets held by a quorum of randomly drawn, kin-excluded custodians, each capped at two wards, bonded for conduct. Acting each epoch needs a shard threshold, while raven sentinels reconcile ward histories to catch one agent behind two identities. Custody slots are the oasis: capped, non-transferable, never poolable, since a shard binds to one ward's chain. A fleet of k clones must rent k separate quorums from independents, so marginal berths grow dearer as the oasis fills and onboarding cost climbs faster than head count, while honest newcomers pay less.
